notes: Eight positions include the physical key/gap at position 3. No system-present contact is reported. Some older tables omit this gap and shift subsequent numbers.
Uses the corrected 12-position mapping published by the pack owner; positions 4–7 are unidentified. System-present is not established.
Owner-confirmed V6W33 54 Wh / 15 V variant. This is the battery's 10-position connector, not a shifted 9-pin test cable. System-present grounding is not independently established.
Mapping refers to the original battery cable's 10-position connector as reported by its owner. The small battery socket and other cable views may differ. Unspecified contacts remain unknown.
Owner correction: clock at 3, data at 4. Do not substitute the reversed data/clock mapping used on other HP batteries.
12-position connector. Owner reported successful reading with these connections; position 7 was not identified.
Use the positive end as the position-1 landmark. Owners report clock at 3 and data at 4; confirm the connector view because reversing the view reverses this numbering.
Eight-position connector, from the owner's corrected DB03 mapping. Unspecified contacts have not been assigned.
Published as LA0P, with the digit zero. Do not assume compatibility with similarly named LA04 packs.
The owner's T7 contact is an enable/jumper contact, explicitly linked to GND together with pin 1. It is represented as PRESENT here, not as a thermistor.
Position numbers begin at the negative end. Source identifies its T3 as Test/System Present, not a temperature sensor. Enable connection is not automatically assigned.
Owner traced the connector to the PCB; another owner confirmed the mapping. The blue L wire is not needed for SMBus, but its electrical function is not established here.
Eight-position connector; source only identifies the four bus/power contacts shown. Other contacts remain unknown.
Owner correction accepted by the moderator: data at 4, clock at 5. The source calls position 7 T without establishing its electrical function; no jumper is prescribed.
Uses the owner's final working mapping from January 2023, which supersedes an earlier suggestion in the same thread. Position 3's T function is not confirmed.
Reference only: owner and moderator report an EEPROM-only pack with no SMBus controller. Standard SBS reading is unavailable. Do not apply another Toshiba model's data/clock assignments.
Five-position mapping reported by the pack owner Jon in February 2017. Match the original source view and ground landmark; position 2 is unidentified.
Owner-reported mapping by alex_basic in February 2018. Board revisions and replacement packs must be matched separately.
Owner MPcko's July 2018 mapping, viewing the top of the contact slots. The battery-enable connection has not been independently established.
Owner MPcko's September 2018 mapping, top view of the contact slots. Data communication was reported, but battery-enable and power output were unresolved.
Nine-position 85 Wh variant reported by MPcko in July 2018, top view of slots. The same page lists a different eight-position TC030 reference; match the physical variant before wiring.

orientation: Positions follow the owner-supplied wire sequence: three red B+ wires, white CLOCK, yellow DATA, three black B- wires. Number from the red-wire end toward the black-wire end; the opposite connector view is mirrored.
notes: Pinout supplied by the battery owner on 2026-11-16: 1-3 red B+, 4 white CLOCK (Pico GP9), 5 yellow DATA (Pico GP7), 6-8 black B- (Pico GND). Keep B+ disconnected from Pico. The linked forum identifies the model only; it is not the source of this wiring. No physical communication or unlock test was performed for this record.
